svg.text: FIT CHECK REQUIRED · component-side coordinates · USB plug enters perpendicular to board
Socket flange screws onto a raised cradle.
Tiny PCB and insulated leads hang below it.
Three mounting points support a rigid, removable board.
Separate broad pads meet the curved skull.
Compliant adhesive interface; plastic type still unknown.
Measure flange hole centres and PCB depth.
Check plug clearance, cable bend and skull fit.
Side view is conceptual, not to scale. Mount circles reserve 4 mm radius.
26 × 32 holes · 2.54 mm grid · assumed socket row spacing 25.4 mm · insulated underside wires; crossings do not join
